name: the quiet mark is never set
why: No <html data-mbu-quiet>: String Theory's launchers and dock stay over our table (the state before #938).

name: the render tail does not report the table
why: _mbuTableShown() is what tells the quiet mark a table of ours is there.

name: the quiet mark stays up in Event Horizon's view
why: In EH's view the launchers are its business; the mark has to go while it shows.

name: another script's quiet mark is overwritten
why: The protocol: each flag has one owner; never take over a value that is not ours.

name: another script's quiet mark is removed
why: The protocol: remove a flag only if its value is still ours.

name: the ☰ row does nothing
why: The script that sets the quiet mark must offer its own way back (#938).

name: the menu launchers follow the loaded page, not the one EH shows
why: After an in-view move MusicBrainz's hidden body is still the page the tab loaded; the launchers must follow <html data-mbu-page>.
grep: follow the page Event Horizon shows

name: a button item on the loaded page presses nothing
why: Without the immediate resume the item only switches EH off; the record waits for a reload that never comes.
grep: a button item on the loaded page

name: the reloaded page ignores the handoff record
why: After EH's reload into MusicBrainz's page the record is what says which button to press.

name: the buttons carry no definition index
why: The record names the button by its index in the definition; without data-mb-def-idx nothing matches.

name: a stale handoff record still presses
why: A record older than the TTL is from another visit; pressing it would start a fetch out of nowhere.

name: a handoff record for another page still presses
why: The record belongs to the page EH reloaded into, not to whatever page loads next.

name: Ctrl+L is not kept from Event Horizon
why: Our direct Ctrl+L (Load from disk) and EH's history.forward() both fired; EH's listener runs first.

edits.find:
e.preventDefault();
                Lib.debug('shortcuts', 'Ctrl+L kept from Event Horizon (its forward) for Load from disk.');
edits.replace: Lib.debug('shortcuts', 'Ctrl+L kept from Event Horizon (its forward) for Load from disk.');

name: Ctrl+L is taken from Event Horizon even when ours does not act
why: With direct Ctrl+letter shortcuts off (the default) our Ctrl+L does nothing; taking it from EH would only break EH's forward.

name: a single-table render is not marked data-mbu-foreign
why: renderFinalTable()'s table is ours after the rows move in; ISRC Scout and mbuTip must leave it alone too.
